message: そして誰もいなくなった
KiraFes is finally tomorrow!
Still, there's no time to get all sentimental!

name: Misa
message: 「KiraFes is finally tomorrow!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heeere you go, Synn. This is the accounting report」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. Approved. Stamp」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey. Can I eat these biscuits?」

name: Misa
message: 「This is our first major event since these Student Council members were elected. We must make it a success no matter what!」

name: Misa
message: 「That is our sacred duty!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is the final version of the exhibitor list. A labor of love」

name: Misa
message: 「We shall unite as one, never letting our guard down until KiraFes concludes, and fulfill the responsibilities entrusted to us」

name: Misa
message: 「And thus, we shall exalt the name of the Ryuusei Academy Student Council--」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna eat the biscuits, okay? Time to dig iiin」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't eat them all by yourself」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmmm, delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ummm, what about the security roster--」

name: Misa
message: 「It's been done for ages」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, thanks」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no need to thank me. It's only natural」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like Misa said, we definitely have to make this a success. For everyone's sparkling, shining school life」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「*Sigh*... Sakura-kun, you really are an airhead」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your heart just skipped a beat for Synn-sama, didn't it. Hey, come on」

name: Misa
message: 「Did not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san, please exercise a little restraint」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehh~~, come on, it's fine, it's fine」

name: Ria
message: 「Working hard is great and all, but relax a little more♪ If you don't loosen up your shoulders, you won't last until the end of KiraFes, ya know~?」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama...... I am deeply moved that you care so much about me\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan cares about everybody, man. You ain't the only special one, Hisu」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now. I believe the fair thing to do here is to verify which one of you she cares about more」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come! Vice President-san shall take Senpai-san's right hand, and President-san shall take his left----」

name: Shio
message: 「Pardon the intrusion while you are busy」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Big trouble, big trouble. Apparently they're short on materials for the stage~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was requested should have already been prepared, though」

name: Shio
message: 「Multiple scoundrels have been spotted taking more than their allotted share」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say. I cannot forgive anyone who disrupts order!」

name: Shio
message: 「Other patrol committee members are currently conducting an inspection, so we should know the details by the time I return to the guardhouse」

name: Misa
message: 「We must retrieve them before they use them to set up their exhibits...... I'm heading out immediately」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall accompany you」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep it peaceful, okay...... and they're gone」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President-san's family is always charging recklessly ahead, aren't they. Nom」

name: Sally
message: 「Aw man, the fun's over...... *sigh*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, and also, Nana-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hm? What? Actually, why did you come along too, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We arranged the buffet layout just like the plan said, but now that we're actually doing it, it looks like all sorts of problems are popping up~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just figure something out on your end」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Haha~. Just what are you expecting out of me, I wonder~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... Yeah, that's just the kind of girl you are」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's my bestie. You really get me, don't ya~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Synn. I'm stepping out for a bit, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, have a good one」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know you'll feel lonely without me around, so hold onto this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A good luck charm. Alright, I'm off!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, 'Inviting Financial Fortune,' is it? Ah, the classic 'if you pity me, give me money' approach」

name: Synn
message: 「I think that's slightly off the mark」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, I've always, always wondered about this. What even is money, anyway?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like she still hasn't figured it out」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Omake truly lacks wisdom. You see, money is--」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. We've got more important things to do right now than talk about money」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hello there. Looks like y'all are mighty busy」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Ayane-chan, what brings you here?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It ain't much, just a little somethin' to keep your spirits up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it isn't much, please don't bother bringing it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then. Allow me to take this back」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. Looks yummy! Gonna eat it, gonna eat it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What an honest little dear. Ria, mind if I take this one home with me?」

name: Ria
message: 「No~pe\s04」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, how mean」

name: Sally
message: 「Gonna eat it, gonna eat it, gonna eat it right now」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. Wait until everyone gets back. Hold on, when did biscuits appear!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The little tagalong ate it all. I saw the whole thing from start to finish.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stop her instead of just watching」

name: Sally
message: 「It wasn't just me! Angel-face over here was eating it too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was roughly one to ten.」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, you ate at least seven」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, how lively. Watching the two of you frolic so innocently like little children warms my heart.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is 'heartwarming' really the word」

name: Synn
message: 「There wasn't much left anyway, so it's fine, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let me correct myself. Seven to seventy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that's better」

name: Sally
message: 「--Wait, don't mess with me! That's the exact same ratio!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I made sure it stayed the same.」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr, you little angel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I am not an angel! I am merely as cute and pure as one!」

name: Sally
message: 「Angel, angel, angel, angel, angel, angel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Guhhh. You have quite an attitude for a mere tagalong!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What lovely wings. They're as graceful as a celestial maiden's robes. Truly, they feel wonderful to touch」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I don't have any wings!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayane-chan, didn't you need something?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I just finished arranging the Japanese sweets corner, so I thought I'd have you take a look. You seem busy, though, so never mind.」

name: Sally
message: 「Klutz can't even hide her own wings!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't want to hear that from a tagalong who's always floating around lazily!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Ria-senpai. I'll handle things here, so could you go take a look?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, got it. I'll be right back」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged. I'll be borrowin' Ria for a bit. I'll return her as soon as I can, so bear with me」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm an intellectual worker, you know! Looking all fluffy and lazy is just on the outside!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What Omake-san thinks about is hardly impressive. It's all just beef bowls, sweets, and evil schemes anyway.」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't think about beef bowls or sweets! If I think about them, I'll just get even hungrier!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not denying the evil schemes...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then you're barely thinking about anything at all, aren't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「An intellectual worker who doesn't think about anything... Pfft.」

name: Sally
message: 「G-Grrr, you're pissing me off, angel! Today's the day I show you who's on top!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You've got quite the nerve saying that to me, the one who defeated Omake-san's boss with ease! I'll teach you your place!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, you two! We're in the middle of Student Council activities--」

name: Sally
message: 「Acting all high and mighty when you didn't even beat him by yourself! I'm the one who's gonna teach you your place!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You asked for it... Don't blame me when you regret this.」

name: Sally
message: 「Who's gonna regret anything! Take it outside!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gladly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte! Sally-chan! ...They left...」
...It suddenly went quiet.
Amid the bustle of everyone preparing for KiraFes, only the Student Council room was silent.

name: Synn
message: 「...Sure got quiet.」

name: Azel
message: 「It really did get quiet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel!? Where did you come from, why, and how!?」

name: Azel
message: 「What's all this commotion?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me... you didn't know KiraFes is tomorrow?」

name: Azel
message: 「……Kirafes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah……」
I dropped to my knees in defeat.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait--hold on, don't leave just yet!」

name: Azel
message: 「……Let go」

name: Synn
message: 「Then at least tell me why you suddenly popped up」

name: Azel
message: 「It was noisy, so I went to the next room. I came out because it got quiet」

name: Synn
message: 「……Were you in the reference room since this morning?」
Apparently so.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. If you've got that much free time, help us prep for Kirafes」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, huh? Azel?」
He left.
Everyone left.
Only I remained.
I suddenly need to use the bathroom…….
And then there were none, huh.
